#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    bool inside = false;
    int word = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        if (ch == '(' || ch == ')' || ch == '_') {
            if (word > 0) {
                if (inside) {
                    insideWords++;
                } else {
                    maxOutside = max(maxOutside, word);
                }
                word = 0;
            }
            if (ch == '(') {
                inside = true;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                inside = false;
            }
        } else {
            word++;
        }
    }

    maxOutside = max(maxOutside, word);
    cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;
    return 0;
}
